name: Mock STT
summary: A speech-to-text provider that never transcribes. It is a wiring test.
description: Registers as a speech-to-text provider and returns one deterministic sentence per utterance describing the audio it was handed: byte count, sample count, sample rate, mean amplitude. No model, no download, no GPU, no delay. If that line reaches your conversation after you speak, the whole path — capture, endpointing, transport, the plugin protocol, the result returning to the chat — works, and anything still wrong is in the model rather than the plumbing. The smallest possible STT plugin: 59 lines.
